sheets.prompt: Character model sheet for 3D modelling and rigging, two full-body views side by side on a plain light cream background: on the left the front view, on the right the back view, both the same size and standing on the same level line. The exact creature of the reference image, the dune mummer, with the same proportions, colours and details: one rounded gourd-shaped body that is head and torso at once with no neck, sage green shading to darker olive green; a smooth pale cream oval mask on the upper front of the body with two short narrow black slit eyes and nothing else on it; a flat terracotta-salmon rectangular patch on the chest just under the mask; short sage-green sleeves; big rust-orange padded gauntlets with a dark band at the wrist and broad mitten-like hands; short sturdy legs in rust-orange boots with sand-coloured toe caps. It stands in a strict T-pose: both arms held straight out to the sides at shoulder height, perfectly horizontal, palms facing down, hands open and empty; legs straight and a little apart, feet flat and pointing forward. The back view shows the smooth back of the gourd body without the mask, the backs of the sleeves, gauntlets and boots. Empty hands, no club, no weapon, no props. Even flat lighting, no cast shadows, no ground shadow, orthographic view with no perspective, the whole body in frame with a margin all round, clean fine ink contours and flat colours as in the reference. Avoid: club, weapon, stick, props, shadow, ground shadow, perspective, background scenery, text, lettering, labels, watermark, extra limbs.
